title: pinguicula vulgaris subsp. alpicola
intro: Pinguicula vulgaris subsp. alpicola, commonly known as Alpine Butterwort, is a carnivorous plant species belonging to the family Lentibulariaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Butterwort include wound healing, immune system stimulation, and the management of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
